content.introduction: According to Firstpost, the 2026 US midterm elections saw significant victories for the Democratic party, with Roy Cooper flipping a long-held Republican Senate seat in North Carolina. The global markets reacted to these results, with technology stocks in Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan coming under pressure due to concerns over tighter scrutiny of artificial intelligence investments. However, Indian markets bucked the trend. The sources do not provide specific details on the exact impact on global markets or the detailed results of other state elections.
